compiled_state.title: RED: Add regression test for worktree session-head sync
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Create a failing regression test that verifies worktree-session-head-sync.sh correctly syncs a sub-agent worktree (created from main HEAD) to the session HEAD.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Given:**
- A bare remote git repository
- A main repo with a session worktree that has 1+ commits ahead of main
- The session branch is pushed to the remote
- A "sub-agent worktree" created from main HEAD (simulating Claude Code's isolation: worktree behavior)
- SESSION_BRANCH and SESSION_HEAD env vars set to the session branch and its HEAD SHA

**When:**
- worktree-session-head-sync.sh runs inside the sub-agent worktree

**Then:**
- The sub-agent worktree HEAD SHA equals the session HEAD SHA
- The exit code is 0

**Test must FAIL RED** before worktree-session-head-sync.sh exists (script not found / exit non-zero).

## File Impact

### Files to Create
- tests/hooks/test-worktree-session-head-sync.sh

## Done Definitions

- [ ] Test file exists at tests/hooks/test-worktree-session-head-sync.sh
- [ ] Test is executable (chmod +x applied)
- [ ] Test fails RED when worktree-session-head-sync.sh is absent or missing from plugins/dso/scripts/
- [ ] Test uses source tests/lib/assert.sh helpers (assert_eq, assert_contains, print_summary)
- [ ] Test simulates bare remote + session worktree + sub-agent worktree pattern
- [ ] Test name is discoverable via test-batched.sh fuzzy match (filename contains 'worktreesessionheadsyncsh' normalized)

## Retry Budget

Max 2 retry attempts if the test file itself has syntax errors.
